result.requirement: The system shall calculate a quality score for each Store Partner based on order preparation accuracy and customer feedback records.
result.business_need: The business needs to objectively measure store performance to incentivize high-quality order preparation and identify partners requiring operational support.
functional_behaviour: The system shall aggregate order preparation accuracy metrics derived from Order Request fulfillment against the assigned Fulfillment Task.
The system shall incorporate qualitative ratings from Feedback Records associated with completed deliveries.
The system shall normalize individual scores into a unified quality metric for each Store Partner.
The system shall expose the calculated quality score to the Fulfillment Supervisor for review and action.
The system shall update the Store Partner Agreement status if the score falls below a defined threshold.
related_information_requirements: Order preparation accuracy rate per Store Partner
business_rules: A Store Partner's quality score must be calculated only after at least three completed Fulfillment Tasks.
Negative feedback records regarding product quality must reduce the overall quality score.
The quality score must be recalculated whenever a new Feedback Record is submitted for a completed task.
Store Partners with scores below the minimum threshold must be flagged for review by the Fulfillment Supervisor.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner has completed three or more Fulfillment Tasks with associated Feedback Records.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the latest Feedback Record for that partner.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates and displays an updated quality score reflecting the latest performance data.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner has fewer than three completed Fulfillment Tasks or no Feedback Records.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to calculate the quality score.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system displays a 'Data Insufficient' status instead of a numeric score.
